CustomCommands_Config_CommandsDesc: Configure custom command-line commands triggered directly by keywords.
CustomCommands_Config_ParameterDesc:
Supports parameter substitution:
· %s1, %s2 … (or {1}, {2} …): the 1st, 2nd … argument
· %s (or {}): all input as a single argument
· Input is used only via placeholders; with none, the configured parameters run as-is
· Placeholders are auto-quoted; do not add quotes yourself
· {currentDirectory}:the inline search directory, automatically quoted; do not add quotes. Only available in inline search.
CustomCommands_Config_ShowInQuickNavDesc: Also list this command as an entry in the Quick Navigation menu (the popup triggered by double/middle-clicking empty space), not just as a keyword-triggered result.
CustomCommands_Config_SubMenuDesc: Nests this command under a submenu in the Quick Navigation menu. Use "/" to nest multiple levels deep, e.g. "Tools/Network" for a two-level submenu. Leave empty to show at the top level. Only applies when "Show in Quick Navigation" is on.
CustomCommands_PluginDesc: Custom commands plugin. Allows users to define shortcuts, aliases, and external command triggers.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_CustomCommandsInstantPr: Executes customized script commands, short aliases, or applications directly by typing them in the search box.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_CustomCommandsQuickNavP: Lists custom commands flagged "Show in Quick Navigation" as entries (optionally nested into submenus) in the Quick Navigation menu.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_CustomCommandsTranslati: Provides translation maps for Custom Commands and script triggers.
CustomCommands_Config_UseCurrentDirector: Use the inline search directory as the working directory, overriding the fixed directory. This option or a {currentDirectory} argument makes the command inline-only; it is absent from main search, quick search and quick navigation.
CustomCommands_Config_MatchKeywordPrefix: Also show this command while its keyword is still being typed: tool can match tool and toola. Off by default to preserve full-keyword matching.
